newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly lower Tuesday, with LME three-month copper slipping after a further rise in LME copper stocks.
COMEX March copper was called unchanged to off 0.20 cent from Monday's close of 102.50 cents a lb. It traded from 102.60 to 102.40 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose 8,750 tonnes Tuesday to 200,500 tonnes, while COMEX copper stocks fell 610 short tons Monday to 18,361 short tons.
With overall stocks rising and the tightness in the prompt market easing, spreads have been widening again this week.

The LME cash-to-three month spread fell to $145.00 a tonne in London by midday Tuesday, well off the high of $331.00 set Jan 28. The COMEX March/May spread ended Monday at 2.65 cents a lb, down from 3.85 cents on January 23.
The focus this week though is likely to be on the LME February options declarations Wednesday, traders said.
